gap_explanation: Evidence acquisition this run covered Hilton only (36 pages, all real, all free). IHG (Holiday Inn / Holiday Inn Express) properties appear repeatedly on BringFido Tampa/St. Petersburg listings; Choice, Wyndham, Best Western and most independent hotels in the 580-row census have a routed URL (373 rows: AWAITING_OFFICIAL_URL or AWAITING_PROPERTY_LEVEL_URL) but no evidence page fetched yet. This is the material, honestly bounded root cause of the gap between 30 confirmed and BringFido's marketing counts -- not a defect in identity/geography/classification, which independently reconcile (FAST 1-11, 15).
